name: xtape
description: An ESP32-S3 devkit with a microSD card in it joins your Wi-Fi and serves the card's music over HTTP:

scripts.font:kalam: npx --yes lv_font_conv --font assets/fonts/Kalam-Regular.ttf --size 36 --bpp 4 --format lvgl --no-compress --range '0x20-0x7F,0xA0-0xFF,0x2010-0x2015,0x2018-0x201D,0x2026' --lv-include lvgl.h --lv-font-name kalam_36 --output components/app/screen_display/font_kalam_36.c
scripts.flash: bash -c 'source ~/esp/esp-idf-6.1/export.sh; lsof -t /dev/cu.usbserial-834430 | xargs kill; idf.py -B build_sunton -p /dev/cu.usbserial-834430 flash monitor'
